needs.proposedSignature: Effect: { op: 'dig'; look: Amount; take: Amount | 'any'; takeTo: 'hand' | 'battlefield' | 'graveyard'; tapped?: boolean; filter?: Filter; rest: 'bottom' | 'top' | 'graveyard' | 'shuffle'; order: 'any' | 'random' }
needs.semantics: 'Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is this creature's power. Put ANY NUMBER of land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.' `dig.take` is a fixed number and the taken cards can only go to hand, so neither the open-ended count nor the battlefield destination can be stated.
needs.clause: When ~ enters, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is ~'s power. Put any number of land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

needs.proposedSignature: AsEnters: { kind: 'devour'; filter: Filter; times: number }  // 'As this creature enters, you may sacrifice any number of <filter>. It enters with <times> times that many +1/+1 counters on it.'
needs.semantics: An as-enters replacement (CR 614.1c): before the permanent enters, its controller may sacrifice any number of permanents matching `filter`; the object then enters with `times * n` +1/+1 counters, through `addCounters` so counter replacements still apply. `filter` defaults to creatures ('Devour 2'), and the printed word supplies it for 'Devour land N' / 'Devour Food N'. The sacrificed set should be bound so a card can read it later.
